name: The Good Stuff
label: Quest
description: The Good Stuff: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Captain Winky tells me that the Dark Irons in the Depths got all the good stuff. Ain't that right, Winky?
See what I'm saying? You need to get in there and bring me back some samples of the good stuff.
Get in there and shake your moneymaker!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can't be bothered right now, friend. Me and Winky got a meeting to attend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oralius starts rummaging through the mountainous pile of fanny packs.
Oralius sticks his large nose into the pile and takes a whiff.
DELICIOUS! Look at all these goodies!
Take one for yourself, friend. There's plenty to go around.
